## Category 1: GravatarAvatar Component (6 tests)

### UAT-1.1: isPledger prop adds blue ring with animation
**Given:** GravatarAvatar rendered with `isPledger={true}`
**Then:** Avatar has blue ring (ring-2 or ring-3 class with ring-blue-500) AND glow-pulse animation
**Verify:** Unit test assertion on className includes ring and animate-glow-pulse

### UAT-1.2: isPledger=false has no ring
**Given:** GravatarAvatar rendered with `isPledger={false}` or prop omitted
**Then:** Avatar has no ring classes and no animation
**Verify:** Unit test assertion — no ring-blue-500 class, no animate-glow-pulse

### UAT-1.3: showPledgeBadge renders checkmark with accessibility
**Given:** GravatarAvatar rendered with `showPledgeBadge={true}`
**Then:** Small checkmark badge appears at bottom-right with `aria-label="Verified pledger"`
**Verify:** Unit test — badge element exists with correct classes and aria-label

### UAT-1.4: All sizes render ring correctly
**Given:** GravatarAvatar rendered at sm, md, lg sizes with `isPledger={true}`
**Then:** Ring is visible and proportional at all sizes (2px for sm/md, 3px for lg)
**Verify:** Unit test for each size variant

### UAT-1.5: Animation keyframes exist in Tailwind config
**Given:** tailwind.config.js
**Then:** Contains `glow-pulse` animation with 3s duration and shadow keyframes
**Verify:** Code inspection of tailwind.config.js

### UAT-1.6: Badge hidden by default
**Given:** GravatarAvatar rendered without `showPledgeBadge` prop
**Then:** No badge element in DOM
**Verify:** Unit test — badge not rendered when prop omitted or false

## Category 2: Navigation Integration (2 tests)

### UAT-2.1: Logged-in pledger sees ring + badge on nav avatar
**Given:** User is logged in AND has pledged
**When:** Navigation renders
**Then:** Avatar in nav bar shows blue ring with animation AND checkmark badge
**Verify:** Playwright MCP screenshot of nav with logged-in pledger

### UAT-2.2: Logged-in non-pledger has no ring or badge
**Given:** User is logged in AND has NOT pledged
**When:** Navigation renders
**Then:** Avatar in nav bar has NO blue ring and NO badge
**Verify:** Unit test or Playwright MCP

### UAT-3.1: Pledger cards show ring + badge
